verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Power-up T_INIT compliance — host T_INIT_MASTER ≥ t_POR + T_INIT_SLAVE + T_INTERNAL_DELAY of peripheral; peripheral powers up in RX-Stop.
HS Entry / Exit (inherited from D-PHY) — LP-11 → LP-01 → LP-00 → HS-0 → Sync 8'b00011101 → packet stream → HS-Trail → LP-11.

Short Packet round-trip — every Processor-sourced Short Packet DT (Sync Events 0x01/0x11/0x21/0x31; EoTp 0x08; CM Off/On 0x02/0x12; Shutdown 0x22; Turn On 0x32; Generic Short Write 0/1/2 0x03/0x13/0x23; Generic READ 0/1/2 0x04/0x14/0x24; DCS Short Write 0/1 0x05/0x15; DCS READ 0x06; Set Max Return Packet Size 0x37).
Long Packet round-trip — Null 0x09, Blanking 0x19, Generic Long Write 0x29, DCS Long Write 0x39, Packed Pixel 0x0E/0x1E/0x2E/0x3E.

Peripheral-sourced Short/Long packets — Acknowledge and Error Report 0x02, EoTp 0x08, Generic Short Read Response 1/2 byte 0x11/0x12, Generic Long Read Response 0x1A, DCS Long Read Response 0x1C, DCS Short Read Response 1/2 byte 0x21/0x22.
Header ECC single-bit correction — inject 1-bit error; verify auto-correction and Error Report bit 8 set after BTA.
Header ECC multi-bit detect — inject 2-bit error; verify packet drop, rest of transmission lost, Error Report bit 9 set.
Long Packet Checksum verification — Annex B test vectors gpcTestData0=0x00 → 0x0F87; gpcTestData1=0x01 → 0x1E0E; gpcTestData2 (24 bytes) → 0xE569; gpcTestData3 (24 bytes) → 0x00F0.
Long Packet Checksum special cases — zero-payload Footer = 0xFFFF; non-checksum-peripheral Footer = 0x0000.
EoTp Short Packet detection (DT=0x08, payload 0x0F0F, ECC 0x01) in HS mode; verify EoTp NOT sent in LP mode.
EoTp enable/disable interoperability with DSI v1.0 peripherals.
Multi-Lane interleave verification — N=1, 2, 3, 4 with SoT in parallel; EoT possibly one byte earlier on some Lanes.
Video Mode Non-Burst with Sync Pulses sequence — VSS+BLLP+VSE / HSS+HSA+HSE+HBP+RGB+HFP per §8.11.2.
Video Mode Non-Burst with Sync Events sequence — VSS+BLLP / HSS+BLLP / HSS+HBP+RGB+HFP per §8.11.3.
Video Mode Burst sequence — HSS+HBP+RGB+BLLP+HFP per §8.11.4; verify LP transition in BLLP for power saving.
Video Mode pixel format coverage — host implements all four (RGB565/RGB666 Packed/RGB666 Loosely Packed/RGB888); peripheral implements at least one.
Set Maximum Return Packet Size — default = 1 at power-on; verify host's 0x37 takes effect on subsequent reads.
BTA — verify Bus Turn-Around escape sequence on Data Lane 0; verify host hands bus to peripheral and peripheral hands bus back to host.
Acknowledge Trigger Message 0x21 — verify peripheral sends after non-Read command with no errors.
Acknowledge and Error Report Short Packet 0x02 — verify all 16 Error Report bits map to correct conditions.
Single-bit ECC on Read — peripheral sends Read Response + Acknowledge and Error Report in same LP transmission.
Multi-bit ECC on any command — peripheral sends ONLY Acknowledge and Error Report (no read data).
Tearing Effect — verify BTA-without-command → peripheral LP Escape trigger byte 0x5D (LSB-first 10111010) → BTA back.
Required timers — HRX_TO, HTX_TO, LTX-P_TO, LRX-H_TO; verify LRX-H_TO > LTX-P_TO ordering.
Optional timers — TA_TO (Turnaround Acknowledge Timeout), PR_TO (Peripheral Reset Timeout).
Contention recovery (Annex A) — Cases 1, 2, 3 (both sides detect / only host detects / only peripheral detects) with Reset Entry command.
Continuous vs Non-Continuous Clock Mode — verify Clock Lane stays HS / returns to LP-11 between bursts as configured.
Host LP clock 67%..150% of peripheral LP clock.
Reserved Data Type codes (DT[3:0] = 0b0000 or 0b1111) trigger DSI DT Not Recognized error (Error Report bit 11).
Endian compliance — bytes LSB-first within byte; multi-byte fields LS byte first.
Display Resolution interoperability — host implements one or more from Table 23.
fields.notes: DSI v1.01.00 does not include a self-contained test plan; the MIPI Alliance Conformance Test Suite provides the formal verification programme. This list captures the design-time verification categories derivable directly from the DSI v1.01.00 spec itself, organized to cover all normative SHALL requirements in §5..§10 plus Annexes A and B.
